text:
Ana: FYI Helios Health is spiking across 3 signals — notable for expansion. Paste from their PM below.
Ana: quick summary — API keys increased from 4 -> 15 in 7d, embedding calls up ~4x, new requests from a "Clinical Insights" team, and one of their engineers flagged cost as a blocker for wider roll out. :eyes:
Ana: copy of PM: "We love the latency, but costs jumped after we added embeddings. Thinking about segmenting usage or pausing some lanes. Can Redwood help us with a cheaper pattern?"
Mike: thanks Ana. Do we have the exact tokens/RPS numbers? ops-bot, can you pull the 7d usage snapshot for helios-prod?
ops-bot: run summary: tokens_total=1,220,456; embeddings=330,120; avg_rps=2.1 -> 9.0 peak (last 48h). new_api_keys=11 (created by 3 distinct emails). report_link: https://redwood.internal/usage/helios/7d
Jules: sounds like a classic multi-team onboarding run. Two immediate asks: 1) enablement for the Clinical Insights team on embedding costs/resharding, 2) propose configuration: batching + prefix caching + quantized model variant for embedding-heavy flows.
Priya: I can run a quick cost delta estimate. If we move embeddings to 8-bit quantized model and enable 256-batch pooling, should drop cost ~35% based on similar accounts. I'll have numbers by EOD.
Mike: also flagging renewal: account renewal in 10 months but expansion could make them enterprise candidate. If cost concerns aren't resolved they might pause growth — risk = medium. Add to QBR prep.
Ana: Can we schedule an enablement session with Clinical Insights next week? They asked for a walkthrough and example prompts. Prefer Tue or Wed morning PST. @Jules can you lead? :calendar:
Jules: yep Tue 10am PST works for me. I'll prepare a short slide + demo notebook showing: embedding sharding, caching prefixes, and a sample prompt/embedding lifecycle. Will include sample curl + Python snippets.
Jules: demo snippet I'll use: ```python
# quick embedding call
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-lite", input=[doc_text])
# show batching example
``` 
Ana: perfect. Also want to offer them a short Dedicated pilot (4 GPU) for 30 days to prove cost per unit. Do we have a template proposal for Dedicated pilots I can send?
Mike: yes — Priya, can you include a cost comparison in the pilot proposal (hosted vs dedicated) and highlight latency/SLO improvements?
Priya: on it. I'll include expected token/unit price, expected latency, and a simple ROI table. Will attach template link: https://redwood.internal/templates/dedicated-pilot
Ana: final ask — capture their feedback on evals/quality drift. They mentioned some hallucination in long-context clinical notes. Can Research help review a small eval set? Jules, can you collect 50 examples from their PM and tag? I'll coordinate with Research after the enablement.
Jules: will collect and anonymize. Tagging plan: intent, hallucination=true/false, severity low/medium/high.
Ana: great. Owners: Ana (CSM) — coordinate scheduling & proposal; Jules (SE) — enablement + eval set; Priya (CS Ops) — cost analysis + pilot numbers; Mike — QBR + renewal tracking. Keeping this thread for the timeline updates.
Mike: noted. I'll add to the account playbook and set a biweekly check for 6 weeks. :white_check_mark:
Ana: thanks team. I'll post the invite once Jules confirms materials. :party:
